verses.en: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Jó:
verses.en_web: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,

verses.en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
verses.pt: Contenderá contra o Todo-Poderoso o censurador? Quem assim argúi a Deus, responda a estas coisas.
verses.en_web: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
verses.en_bbe: Will he who is protesting give teaching to the Ruler of all? Let him who has arguments to put forward against God give an answer.

verses.en: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
verses.pt: Então Jó respondeu ao Senhor, e disse:
verses.en_web: Then Job answered Yahweh,
verses.en_bbe: And Job said in answer to the Lord,

verses.en: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
verses.pt: Eis que sou vil; que te responderia eu? Antes ponho a minha mão sobre a boca.
verses.en_web: “Behold, I am of small account. What shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I am of no value; what answer may I give to you? I will put my hand on my mouth.

verses.en: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
verses.pt: Uma vez tenho falado, e não replicarei; ou ainda duas vezes, porém não prosseguirei.
verses.en_web: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
verses.en_bbe: I have said once, and even twice, what was in my mind, but I will not do so again.

verses.en: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.pt: Então, do meio do redemoinho, o Senhor respondeu a Jó:
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord made answer to Job out of the storm-wind, and said,

verses.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.pt: Cinge agora os teus lombos como homem; eu te perguntarei a ti, e tu me responderás.
verses.en_web: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
verses.en_bbe: Get your strength together like a man of war: I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

verses.en: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
verses.pt: Farás tu vão também o meu juízo, ou me condenarás para te justificares a ti?
verses.en_web: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
verses.en_bbe: Will you even make my right of no value? will you say that I am wrong in order to make clear that you are right?

verses.en: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
verses.pt: Ou tens braço como Deus; ou podes trovejar com uma voz como a dele?
verses.en_web: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
verses.en_bbe: Have you an arm like God? have you a voice of thunder like his?

verses.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
verses.pt: Orna-te, pois, de excelência e dignidade, e veste-te de glória e de esplendor.
verses.en_web: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
verses.en_bbe: Put on the ornaments of your pride; be clothed with glory and power:

verses.en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
verses.pt: Derrama as inundações da tua ira, e atenta para todo soberbo, e abate-o.
verses.en_web: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
verses.en_bbe: Let your wrath be overflowing; let your eyes see all the sons of pride, and make them low.

verses.en: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.pt: Olha para todo soberbo, e humilha-o, e calca aos pés os ímpios onde estão.
verses.en_web: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
verses.en_bbe: Send destruction on all who are lifted up, pulling down the sinners from their places.

verses.en: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
verses.pt: Esconde-os juntamente no pó; ata-lhes os rostos no lugar escondido.
verses.en_web: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
verses.en_bbe: Let them be covered together in the dust; let their faces be dark in the secret place of the underworld.

verses.en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
verses.pt: Então também eu de ti confessarei que a tua mão direita te poderá salvar.
verses.en_web: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
verses.en_bbe: Then I will give praise to you, saying that your right hand is able to give you salvation.

verses.en: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
verses.pt: Contempla agora o hipopótamo, que eu criei como a ti, que come a erva como o boi.
verses.en_web: “See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
verses.en_bbe: See now the Great Beast, whom I made, even as I made you; he takes grass for food, like the ox.

verses.en: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
verses.pt: Eis que a sua força está nos seus lombos, e o seu poder nos músculos do seu ventre.
verses.en_web: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
verses.en_bbe: His strength is in his body, and his force in the muscles of his stomach.

verses.en: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
verses.pt: Ele enrija a sua cauda como o cedro; os nervos das suas coxas são entretecidos.
verses.en_web: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
verses.en_bbe: His tail is curving like a cedar; the muscles of his legs are joined together.

verses.en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
verses.pt: Os seus ossos são como tubos de bronze, as suas costelas como barras de ferro.
verses.en_web: His bones are like tubes of brass. His limbs are like bars of iron.
verses.en_bbe: His bones are pipes of brass, his legs are like rods of iron.

verses.en: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
verses.pt: Ele é obra prima dos caminhos de Deus; aquele que o fez o proveu da sua espada.
verses.en_web: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
verses.en_bbe: He is the chief of the ways of God, made by him for his pleasure.

verses.en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
verses.pt: Em verdade os montes lhe produzem pasto, onde todos os animais do campo folgam.
verses.en_web: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
verses.en_bbe: He takes the produce of the mountains, where all the beasts of the field are at play.

verses.en: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
verses.pt: Deita-se debaixo dos lotos, no esconderijo dos canaviais e no pântano.
verses.en_web: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
verses.en_bbe: He takes his rest under the trees of the river, and in the pool, under the shade of the water-plants.

verses.en: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.pt: Os lotos cobrem-no com sua sombra; os salgueiros do ribeiro o cercam.
verses.en_web: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
verses.en_bbe: He is covered by the branches of the trees; the grasses of the stream are round him.

verses.en: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
verses.pt: Eis que se um rio trasborda, ele não treme; sente-se seguro ainda que o Jordão se levante até a sua boca.
verses.en_web: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, if the river is overflowing, it gives him no cause for fear; he has no sense of danger, even if Jordan is rushing against his mouth.

verses.en: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
verses.pt: Poderá alguém apanhá-lo quando ele estiver de vigia, ou com laços lhe furar o nariz?
verses.en_web: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
verses.en_bbe: Will anyone take him when he is on the watch, or put metal teeth through his nose?
